title: TurboVLA Runs a Real-Time VLA at 32 Hz on One RTX 4090
summary: Standard VLA models route perception through a large language model on an LLM-centric V -> L -> A pathway, paying that cost on every policy invocation. TurboVLA reformulates it as a direct V + L -> A mapping: vision and language are encoded independently and exchange information directly, with no LLM sitting between perception and action. The reported operating point is 32 Hz inference on a single RTX 4090 in under 1 GB of VRAM.
whyItMatters: Sub-gigabyte, 32 Hz control collapses the hardware bill for a generalist policy from a server rack to a consumer GPU — and 32 Hz is fast enough for closed-loop contact-rich work, not just open-loop demos. Dropping the LLM from the inner loop challenges the assumption that a language backbone has to mediate perception and action at every timestep.
